## The artifact (gift format)

Paste the capability as a `/gift`-packaged file — the `gift:/from:/created:/contents:/stripped:/what-it-does:/touches:` header plus the body. If you haven't packaged it yet, say **"gift my X"** to your Sasha first.

```markdown
<paste the gift file here>
```

## How long it's been in real use

Weeks of actual use, roughly how often it runs, and whether anyone besides you has adopted it.

## What it survived

The honest question: what went wrong along the way and how the current version handles it. A capability that never met reality isn't ready to promote.

## Stripped attestation

- [ ] I confirm the artifact contains no names, employers, personal paths, file contents, or credentials — architecture only (`stripped: yes` in the header is attested by me).

---

*Curation note: one pair of hands merges; most promotions are declined, and that's the point. A decline usually means "not universal enough for Core," not "not good" — keep gifting it directly.*
